**5h**

At first I started by learning about PCB boards and how they work. Then I looked into what parts would be best to use for my project. Spent a large portion of total time learning about how to power and connect the different parts of my project. Designed the project for the most part, still need to work out finer details and also code the Arduino. Learned about electricity and circuits in general as well. Ended up adding and removing some components at first as well.

### 2026-10-11 – Started with reviewing the schematic I made last time. Needed to put in a logic level translator for 5v to 3.3v and vice versa. Started on the Arduino code part, but that might take a while to finish.

**10h**

Started with reviewing the schematic I made last time. Needed to put in a logic level translator for 5v to 3.3v and vice versa. Started on the Arduino code part, but that might take a while to finish.  Pretty much finished the board at the end of this session. I think small tweaks are still to be made just for it to be the best. I don't fully know if the electricity will flow correctly. Lots of coding needs to be done as well. for the Arduino.
